interpretation: All records are failed rigid development missions, not formal trials. The 2 s outbound transition is a clock event, not evidence of stable standing. Force means are samples, not physical impulse integrals. actual_Fz_at_control retains the preceding physics-end measurement; the separate original post-step GRF is about 2 ms after the command and is not used here. Event counts use simulator time minus its 0.2 ms origin and do not establish instantaneous causality. Global means do not rule out local instability or establish its unique cause.
